operatingHoursDisplay: Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat 9am-1pm. Closed Sunday and public holidays.
businessModelStatement: PestToClear is a matching service run by the team behind Junk to Clear. We pass your enquiry to a partner pest-control firm, which inspects, quotes and carries out the treatment.

formSubmit.note: Same endpoint as HomeToClean. FormSubmit may ask for a fresh activation the first time a new site posts to it, so send one test enquiry from the live domain and click the confirmation link. The address appears only here and in the compiled form script; the audit fails if it shows anywhere else.
